notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/sega/nl_elim.cpp (NETLIST_START(elim), CC0-1.0, Aaron Giles) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/elim-sound.nets.

Compared with the Sound Board drawing 800-3174 rev B, sheets 7 and 8 of 8 (doc cff008c00810 pp65-68, each sheet printed in two halves), and its parts list (pp30-35), 2026-10-20. Every passive value in this file agrees with the parts list -- 188 parts, none different -- and the list shows that R24 and C42, which MAME's file queries, do not exist. All values are the Eliminator ones in MAME's variant table (R79 2M is fitted), and no Zektor part or jumper is drawn. The latch bit assignment (U34 74LS374 for the HI port, U35 for the LO port, D0 unused on the LO side), the 7406/7407 buffers, the noise source (U4, U3) and sum buffer U12, the thrust, skitter, enemy ship and background channels (U10, U11, U5, U1, U13, U15, U16, U25), the PSG input U29, explosions 1-3, fireball and bounce (U6-U9, U14, the CD4011 one-shots U17-U19), the torpedo VCOs and counters (U20-U23) and the summing resistors R6-R10 all agree with MAME pin for pin and value for value, transistor and diode orientation included; R36 does feed torpedo 2's D6, as with DISABLE_TORPEDO2_NOISE off.

The 200 Hz A/B, 10 Hz, 50 Hz and 100 Hz clocks, which MAME runs as ideal clocks, are CD4069 RC oscillators on the sheet (U32 and U31 with R139-R143 and C65-C69), on exactly the pins MAME parks, with the values MAME's comment gives; they are put back here. U5 and U13 are printed NE555 (MAME: LM555, the same part). The PSG's three outputs (U30 pins 1, 4, 5) are tied straight onto R133 680 ohm; R_PSG_1-3 are only MAME's model of the chip, so that node stays a port.

Not in this file: the CPU interface (U30 AY-3-8912, U33-U41), the final amplifier and mute (U2, Q1, R1-R5, R11-R13, C1, C4) and the bypass capacitors, which are on the sheets with the values MAME's comments give. R3 is not part of the final amplifier's gain network, as MAME's comment says: it brings contact 3 onto the summing node.
conflicts: this scan drops two short line segments -- Q3's base lead (sheet 7, zone C3) and U19 pin 4 into its second gate (sheet 8, zone D6) -- where MAME's reading is the only one the drawing allows; the identical one-shots elsewhere on sheet 8 draw the line. MAME's is kept.
